item.title: Search for sticky-fingered honey thief
item.description: Otago Gold Honey co-owner Tim Sinclair stands guard outside his Waihola stall. Photo: Stephen Jaquiery The owner of a South Island honey stall is on the hunt for a brazen and chronic sticky-fingered honey thief who has allegedly been helping herself to the stall’s product without paying for years.
